description: Tavuk Sis is a beloved Turkish classic featuring succulent pieces of chicken marinated in a flavorful blend of yogurt and spices, then grilled to perfection. These juicy skewers offer a delightful taste of Turkey, perfect for a family meal or a summer barbecue. Enjoy the tender chicken with fresh vegetables and warm flatbread.

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs

ingredients.notes: soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes if using

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken
instructions.text: Cut the boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs into uniform 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes. This ensures even cooking. Place the chicken pieces in a large mixing bowl.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the plain yogurt, olive oil, minced garlic, tomato paste, sweet paprika, ground cumin, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, and fresh lemon juice until well combined. This creates the signature flavorful marinade for Tavuk Sis.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pour the prepared marinade over the chicken pieces in the large bowl. Toss the chicken thoroughly to ensure every piece is evenly coated. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, for maximum flavor absorption.

instructions.title: Thread the Skewers
instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, ensure they have been soaked in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent burning. Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the skewers, packing them gently but not too tightly. You can alternate with bell peppers or onions if desired, though traditionally Tavuk Sis is just chicken.

instructions.title: Grill the Chicken Skewers
instructions.text: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (about 400F/200C). Lightly oil the grill grates to prevent sticking. Place the chicken skewers on the hot grill. Cook for 15-20 minutes, turning every 4-5 minutes, until the chicken is golden brown, cooked through, and the internal temperature reaches 165F (74C).

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Once cooked, remove the Tavuk Sis chicken skewers from the grill. Let them rest for a few minutes before serving. Garnish with fresh parsley or mint, and serve hot with Turkish pilaf, fresh salad, flatbread, and a side of cacik (yogurt sauce). Enjoy your authentic Turkish meal!

tips: For the most tender chicken, marinate for at least 4 hours or overnight. The yogurt helps tenderize the meat beautifully.
If you dont have a grill, you can cook Tavuk Sis in a hot cast-iron pan or bake them in the oven at 400F (200C) for about 20-25 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve Tavuk Sis with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice just before eating to brighten the flavors, and definitely try it with a simple side of Turkish rice pilaf.
